title: Register and Controller
objective: Use register for a native input and Controller for a non-native controlled picker without creating duplicate form state.
predict: The naive widget never reports its selected rating to handleSubmit; Controller makes the custom control participate in the form.
expectedBehavior: Click or keyboard-activate the rating button twice, then submit; the handler must receive rating 3 rather than 1. Verify the title is also registered.
commonFailure: The custom control never receives the form-owned value or onChange handler.
securityBoundary: A rating picker still needs a semantic accessible name and keyboard focus; wrapping an inaccessible custom control in Controller does not make it accessible.
